reviews.t: Many people say bulk but bulk means many of the same thing.
reviews.x: Many people say bulk but bulk means many of the same thing for a lower price. If you want more than one of the products the sellers give to you then this is great but if you want assorted you might as well check out some other things. Just to clear this up

claims.text: Many reviewers complain about excessive duplicate items and repeated colors, especially among lipsticks and lip glosses.
Several reviewers describe the makeup as cheap, junk, or poor quality.
Some reviewers report receiving broken, damaged, or unusable items.
A few reviewers note the set is heavily lipstick and lip gloss with little variety.
Some reviewers found the set acceptable for gifting or their situation despite duplicates.
